---
title: Rice Arancine
id: MAR-0016
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 6
time_min: 55
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g rice
- 150 g peas
- 200 g ragù
- 80 g breadcrumbs
- 60 g all-purpose flour
- 40 g butter
- 40 g Grana Padano
- 0.5 sachet saffron
- 2 eggs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Bring 5 dl of lightly salted water to a boil and add the rice and peas.
2. Cook, stirring often with a wooden spoon, adding more boiling water as needed.
3. Remove the rice when al dente, it should have absorbed all the water.
4. Add the butter, cheese, saffron, and one egg, mixing well; season with salt and pepper.
5. When the rice has cooled slightly, shape it into arancine; form a hollow in the center, fill with ragù, and close, pressing the rice lightly between your hands.
6. Dredge the arancine in flour, then in beaten egg, and finally in breadcrumbs.
7. Fry them in oil, browning evenly, drain and place on paper towels.
